image_description: A close-up photograph of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) displayed against a neutral beige wall. The armor features a central vertical ridge, curved anatomical contours for the chest and abdomen, and visible rivets near the top edge. The surface is highly reflective with specular highlights indicating a smooth metal texture. Ornamental etched lines curve across the lower torso section.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like cuirass or plastron at a fine-grained level.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, specular highlights, and surface texture for any AI-generation anomalies.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the curved metal and ensure the depth map aligns with the physical contours of the armor.
To check for boundary sharpness and ensure no melting or fusion artifacts exist at the edges of the metal plate against the background.

focus_areas: Metal reflectivity and specular highlight consistency
Anatomical correctness of the torso curvature
Edge sharpness and boundary definition against the background
Presence of realistic manufacturing details (rivets, seams)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection patterns on the metal surface. AI generators often struggle with complex specular highlights on curved metallic surfaces. Verify if the reflections are physically consistent with a single light source. Also, inspect the rivets and etched lines for any signs of smearing or lack of physical depth.
